correctness.rationale: At the resistant-only equilibrium the exact linearized (I,P) subsystem has infection entry kappa*k*M2 and phage-loss entry D+k*M2. The resulting next-generation spectral quantity necessarily contains k in the numerator. Independently, expanding the source's own identity G(lambda2)=-D+k*A2*M2=(D+k*M2)(R0M^2-1) reproduces the same factor. For the fully positive rational witness, the printed square is 250/11>1, the corrected square is 5/22<1, the direct invasion block has trace -31/10 and determinant 17/10, and the source's equilibrium equations simultaneously force M3=200/3 and M3<10. All arithmetic is replayed exactly by the bundled checker.

value.rationale: The displayed resistant reproduction number is the threshold object used to state existence and nonexistence of a positive resistant-phage equilibrium. The omission is therefore structurally meaningful: an exact positive-parameter witness has the printed quantity above one while the actual invasion block is stable and the source's positive-equilibrium equations have no solution. Restoring k reconciles the next-generation calculation with the source's own G(lambda2) identity and gives the correct threshold for interpreting resistant-phage invasion.
